posts.headline: Seattle · 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 免费亲子同乐，探索西雅图最大的城市农场，还能和羊驼、鸡近距离互动。现场音乐、本地美食摊、自然手作、巨型游戏和果园故事时间一应俱全。停车位有限，建议骑行或搭乘公共交通。
posts.description: Join Tilth Alliance on Saturday, September 19; 10 a.m.-3 p.m. for Farm Fest at Rainier Beach Urban Farm & Wetlands, a celebration of urban agriculture and the Southeast Seattle community! Featuring live music, food and drink, community partner booths, and activities for all ages, this family-friendly event is free and open to the public! Enjoy food from a variety of local vendors, dance to musical performances, visit with llamas and chickens, learn from community partner organizations, get creative with nature crafts, try your hand at giant games, stop by for story time in the orchard, and best of all, explore Seattle’s largest urban farm! As parking is limited around the farm, we strongly encourage biking or taking public transportation when possible! Bike racks will be available, generously provided by Bike Works. This event is hosted in partnership with Friends of Rainier Beach Urban Farm and Wetlands and Nurturing Roots.

They also help grind and press fresh apples to make delicious raw cider.

posts.title: Storywalk at Alderwood Park: César’s Cerulean Surprise
posts.headline: Tacoma · 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 📚 可以体验教育与探索主题活动。💛 适合安排周末亲子时光。
posts.description: Walk along and read the Storywalk at Alderwood Park during the park’s open hours. The September/October title is César’s Cerulean Surprise by Jenny Lacika. César asks to borrow his sister Gabi’s cerulean crayon, but Gabi does not know what cerulean is and decides to identify the color by asking yes-no questions. It’s a window into an all-too-familiar sibling dynamic, a slice of life many readers can identify with. Along with the subtle math hints, both Gabi and César sprinkle in Spanish words. Further explanation can be found in an author’s note, along with interactive tips for adults, showing how to encourage the math connections during reading.

posts.description: The Lake Wilderness Arboretum and Maple Valley Library have partnered together to bring a StoryWalk to Maple Valley. StoryWalk is an innovative approach to encouraging people of all ages to get out and walk while enjoying wonderful children’s books. With her wealth of experience, Sharon Chastain, the children’s librarian at the Maple Valley Library, selects the best children’s books for this story walk project. Then the pages are installed in frames along the Arboretum’s Main Looping Trail so as September StoryWalk: This month’s StoryWalk selection, The Girl with Big, Big Questions written by Britney Winn Lee, is a lively picture book about a persistent girl and her quest for knowledge. It celebrates the spirit of curiousity and shows us that asking questions is how we learn and grow – perhaps the perfect book to read as a new school year starts. So get outside, go for a walk, and read a book.

posts.description: Named Washington State’s best pumpkin patch by “Readers Digest” in 2019, and more recently among the best pumpkin farms in the country (!), this farm is justifiably very popular, especially with younger kids. As the Snohomish Valley’s Original Pumpkin Patch, Craven Farm is a decades old tradition for many families. Continue your family tradition or start a new one this fall at Craven Farm! At Craven Farm, we’re dedicated to creating an enjoyable and memorable fall experience for everyone who visits us. Our farm offers an extensive range of activities to suit all age groups, including apple cannons and slingers, fair foods, espresso, and donuts. Our unique attractions like cow trains, wagon rides, multiple acres of themed corn mazes, jump pad & animals are sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. Visit us today and make some unforgettable memories with us this fall! Check out our huge list of pumpkin extravaganzas happening this year.

posts.description: Get ready for fall fun at Swans Trail Farms, just 30 minutes from Seattle! Harvest Festival is open daily from 10 AM–6 PM, with U-Pick apples and pumpkins, family-friendly attractions, farm-fresh food, and plenty of fall memories to make. Don’t miss our magical pumpkin garden, a favorite spot for fall photos! Enjoy the full experience of the Harvest Festival with over 30+ farm fun attractions! Wander through the legendary Washington State Corn Maze, a 12-acre masterpiece meticulously shaped like our state. You’ll navigate 4.5 miles of paths, discovering over 700 state roads and landmarks. Afterward, warm up with our famous apple cider donuts and fresh-pressed cider, or visit our Cidery for a hard cider made with apples from our own orchard. 我们整理了 8 场地区亮点：

1. Seattle：Farm Fest at Rainier Beach Urban Farm and Wetlands

   亮点：免费亲子同乐，探索西雅图最大的城市农场，还能和羊驼、鸡近距离互动。

   Alderwood Park – Tacoma
   亮点：📚 可以体验教育与探索主题活动。

4. Kirkland：Salmon SEEson at 90th St Bridge in Redmond
   90th St Bridge
   亮点：📚 可以体验教育与探索主题活动。

5. Lynnwood：Fall Festival at Bob’s Corn and Pumpkin Farm
   Bob’s Corn and Pumpkin Farm
   趋势关键词：fall festival、pumpkin
   亮点：坐拖拉机下田、闯玉米迷宫、亲手采摘南瓜，沉浸式体验秋日农场。

6. Edmonds：Harvest Festival at Swans Trail Farms
   Swan’s Trail Farms
   趋势关键词：harvest
   亮点：🌿 可以体验户外与运动主题活动。

7. Seattle：Starfire Equipment Drive
   Starfire Sports
   亮点：捐出八成新的足球、球鞋和护腿板，转赠给需要的孩子。

8. Bellevue：Fall City Apple Festival
   Northwest Natural Horsemanship Center
